tasks.notes: Do this after the main Phase 1 deep-work block; it is setup work, not today’s research outcome.

tasks.title: Phase 2B — Understand BOB using the core report only
tasks.notes: Completed 15 Aug: defined BOB, its purpose, report-supported capabilities, safety limits, three POC tests, and validation questions.

tasks.title: Phase 2A — Review Claude’s documentation sheet
tasks.notes: Completed: keep/change/remove review, authoritative template, and blank working copy are all ready.

tasks.title: Phase 1 — Discover what Al Nahreen actually needs
tasks.notes: Research the industry, comparable applications, operational gaps, and administrative work Bob could automate before subscribing.

tasks.title: Phase 3 — Build the IBM Bob subscription experiment plan
tasks.notes: Start with Phase 0 safety setup, then orientation and reverse engineering. Audit errors only after validating BOB's understanding. Plan and approve before one controlled execution.

tasks.title: Complete the E01 and E02 experiment logs
tasks.notes: Complete before Phase 3 implementation. Preserve the exact prompts and raw Bob outputs, then record verdicts, evidence quality, time, corrections, risk, verification effort, and lessons.

tasks.title: Phase 3 — Plan and implement the first validated fix
tasks.notes: Start only after E02 validation and completion of both experiment logs. Use Plan mode first; approve the exact scope before execution.

tasks.title: Validate Bob’s E02 code-health findings
tasks.notes: First task tomorrow. Read every E02 finding, verify its cited code evidence, classify it as confirmed, rejected, or uncertain, and record false positives or missing risks.

tasks.title: Start AI Fluency + map my life for AI leverage
tasks.notes: Start with Claude for Personal / AI Fluency. Then list recurring tasks and classify them: Human-only, AI-assisted, AI-automated, or AI-agent. Choose one small personal workflow to improve immediately. Claude Code comes later as a tool, not the main goal.

tasks.title: Choose one Al Nahreen improvement problem to attack next
tasks.notes: Pick one measurable business problem, define the current baseline, acceptance criteria, and expected operational value before building.

tasks.title: Create first reusable Claude Skill or agent workflow
tasks.notes: After learning the foundations, turn one repeated workflow into a reusable Claude Skill/agent and test it on real work.

tasks.title: Start learning content creation & social media
tasks.notes: First session: choose one primary platform and study positioning, hooks, storytelling, filming, editing, and posting. Then publish a simple first piece instead of waiting for perfect quality.

tasks.title: Start learning sales & connection skills
tasks.notes: First session: learn the basic sales conversation—build rapport, ask good questions, uncover needs, explain value, handle objections, and ask for the next step. Practice with a real product/service you know.

tasks.title: Start learning personal finance & investing
tasks.notes: First session: 30–45 minutes. Learn budgeting, emergency funds, compound interest, stocks vs. ETFs, diversification, and risk. Goal is understanding—not buying anything yet.

tasks.notes: Review the final documents, meet the supervisor for feedback and milestone validation, revise if needed, rehearse, and present to KBM. (Notion: Next Action)
